Any recommendations for a great book on the Meiji restoration and industrialization of Japan?

This is a book that is a little later than you want but it does cover some of the area you want. Look up the Tide at Sunrise by Denis and Peggy Warner. Currently available on Amazon. It is the history of the Russo-Japanese war of 1905. As for the statement that Japan would have defeated Russia is wildly optimistic. After a year and a half of warfare, the war was essentially a stalemate. In the meantime the government of Japan was almost bankrupt and facing economic collapse. Roosevelt stepped in when the Japaneses could not longer borrow money from western bankers, and would have defaulted on the extensive amount of loans that the got before going to war with Russia.
